chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: The traveler should not pray with the resident; and if he does pray, then he should conclude at the two rakʿahs.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs, referring to the shortened prayer of the traveler
key_terms.الْمُسَافِرُ: the traveler, whose salat is shortened in this context
key_terms.الْمُقِيمِ: the resident, one who is not traveling and prays the full salat
key_terms.فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ: then he should conclude and depart from the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a traveler do if he prays behind a resident in congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the traveler praying behind a resident Imam. It indicates that if a traveler joins such a prayer, he should end his prayer after completing two rakʿahs, in accordance with the traveler's shortened salat.
